name: How to Kayak to the Mokulua Islands
description: Step-by-step guide for paddling from Kailua Beach to the Mokulua Islands.

steps.name: Launch from Kailua Beach Park
steps.text: Park at the Kailua Beach Park boat ramp lot. Carry your kayak to the water's edge and launch from the sandy beach.

steps.name: Paddle to Moku Nui
steps.text: Head toward the larger island (Moku Nui). Keep the island at roughly 45 degrees to account for current. Paddle time: 45-60 minutes.

steps.name: Land on the protected side
steps.text: Approach from the leeward (west) side of Moku Nui where the water is calmer. Beach your kayak above the tide line.

steps.name: Explore the island
steps.text: Hike to the summit for panoramic views, explore tide pools on the north side, and look for wedge-tail shearwaters nesting.
